definitions.gloss: coloured and patterned items; non-white laundry
definitions.explanation: Clothes, towels, and linens that are dyed or printed rather than plain white. A laundry-care term: these are washed separately from whites because the dye can run.

examples.japanese: {色柄物|いろがらもの}は{別|べつ}に{洗|あら}う。
この{漂白剤|ひょうはくざい}は{色柄物|いろがらもの}には{使|つか}えない。
examples.english: This bleach can't be used on coloured or patterned items.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{色柄物|いろがらもの}は{色|いろ}{落|お}ちしやすいので、{最初|さいしょ}の{数回|すうかい}は{単独|たんどく}で{洗濯|せんたく}したほうがいい。
examples.english: New coloured items bleed easily, so it's best to wash them on their own the first few times.

notes:
From {色|いろ} (colour) plus {柄|がら} (pattern) plus {物|もの} (item). Learners meet it on detergent bottles and washing-machine instructions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {色柄物|いろがらもの}と{白物|しろもの}: coloureds and whites
- {色柄物|いろがらもの}{用|よう}{洗剤|せんざい}: detergent for coloured items
- {色柄物|いろがらもの}は{別|べつ}{洗|あら}い: wash coloureds separately

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {白物|しろもの}: whites — the counterpart in the same laundry instructions
- {色|いろ}{落|お}ち: colour running, fading — what these instructions are trying to prevent
- {柄物|がらもの}: patterned item — the pattern alone, with no comment on colour
